candidates.excerpt: Sanitary workers and scavengers working at police stations across Telangana staged a protest at the Secretariat, seeking payment of salaries pending for 20 months. Workers said about 4,500 people were affected and appealed to senior officials to clear their dues.

candidates.title: Younger brother kills elder brother for property after returning from US
candidates.excerpt: A property dispute between two brothers turned fatal in Jaipur on Tuesday, when a 58-year-old man allegedly stabbed his elder brother during an altercation in the Bani Park area. Police have arrested the accused.

candidates.title: Samajwadi Party says Revanth Reddy should focus on governance, not matters of faith
candidates.excerpt: The Samajwadi Party criticised Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy over his remarks on Lord Ram and Lord Shiva. The BJP also questioned his comments, while the Congress defended Reddy and accused the BJP of using religious issues for political gain.

candidates.title: Myanmar airstrike toll hits 50 as families gather dead
candidates.excerpt: Witnesses say the military's air force raided the riverside commercial hub in Kyauktaw town in western Rakhine state around midday (05:30 GMT) on September 28

candidates.title: Telangana HC Orders DGP to Identify Cops Accused of Misbehaving With Women BRS MLAs
candidates.excerpt: The BRS MLAs had approached the High Court alleging that police officers misbehaved with them during the protest at the Assembly gate.

candidates.title: Vivek Venkataswamy Highlights Govt's Education Initiatives
candidates.excerpt: Referring to breakfast scheme he inaugurated in Medak district, the minister said students had responded positively to the quality of food being provided under the programme

candidates.title: Gold price prediction: Why are prices down to 7-week low? Check outlook for today
candidates.excerpt: Gold price prediction today: Gold has had a rough month. It's fallen nearly 12% from its August highs, touching a seven-week low of $4,111 an ounce. Treasury yields have been the biggest headwind, with the 30-year touching its highest level since 2002 and the 10-year near its highest since 2007.

candidates.title: From SBI ATM limits to LPG subsidy: Key rule changes from October 1
candidates.excerpt: Several financial rules will change in October, including lower free ATM transactions for some SBI salary account holders, Aadhaar authentication for subsidised LPG, revised NPS charges and new bulk-deposit disclosures. A new UPI MDR framework will take effect from October 15.
